user.title: Connect your Discogs collection
user.description: Enter your Discogs username and a personal access token. Create the token at {token_url} ("Generate new token").

player.title: Choose the speaker
player.description: Records are played through Music Assistant (e.g. with Apple Music as streaming provider).

reconfigure.title: Update Discogs credentials
reconfigure.description: Create a new token at {token_url} if needed.

error.invalid_auth: Discogs rejected the username or token.
error.token_user_mismatch: The token belongs to a different Discogs user.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Vinyl Player is already set up.
abort.already_configured: This Discogs account is already set up.
abort.music_assistant_missing: Music Assistant must be installed and set up in Home Assistant first.
abort.no_players: Music Assistant has no media players yet.

play.name: Play record
play.description: Put a record from the collection on the turntable.

tag_id.name: NFC tag ID
tag_id.description: Play the record linked to this tag instead.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Lift the tonearm and stop playback.

sync.name: Sync Discogs
sync.description: Re-export the Discogs collection and cache missing covers.

link_tag.name: Link NFC tag
link_tag.description: Link an NFC tag ID to a record (leave release empty to unlink).

tag_id.name: Tag ID
tag_id.description: The NFC tag ID (HA tag) or the name you use in the Apple Shortcut.

release_id.name: Discogs release ID
release_id.description: Record to play when the tag is scanned.
